name: Arad
overview: Arad was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Beriah. His mention in Scripture is brief and focused on his genealogical placement within the tribe. No additional notes or distinctive actions are recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Arad is presented as a proper name in Scripture without any provided meaning or divine origin. Therefore, it is recognized simply as the personal name of this individual without further significance noted.
familyAndRelationships: Arad is explicitly identified as the son of Beriah, situating him within a known family line in the tribe of Benjamin. Beyond this father-son relationship, Scripture does not provide additional family details about Arad.
scriptureSignificance: Arad's significance lies primarily in his genealogical mention, which contributes to the record of the tribe of Benjamin's descendants. This brief record helps preserve the historical and tribal lineage important for understanding Israel's family structures as outlined in Scripture. While no further narrative or theological roles are attributed to him, his inclusion underscores the biblical emphasis on heritage and tribal identity.
